audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Pantheon's passive blocks your first auto or spin tick ('his passive blocking your first AA or spin tick', 'his passive negating your first hit', 'Use passive to block your AA/spin ticks').
audit.why: Mortal Will is not a damage block. Riot's text: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The old block-the-first-hit passive no longer exists, so the advice built on it is telling the player to fear something that will not happen — and it hides the real tell, which is his stack counter reaching an empowered cast.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts or attacks; there is no first-hit block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is never described mechanically, and Grand Starfall's landing slow is never tied to Decisive Strike.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (22/21/20/19/18s) is a channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front while he strikes — dumping Judgment into its face is the classic wasted commit, and any CC cancels the channel. Decisive Strike 'breaks free of all slows' on a flat 8s, which specifically defeats the Grand Starfall landing slow. Courage grants tenacity, so popping it as Shield Vault lands shortens the stun. All three come from the mirror audit's findings and match the kits.
audit.corrected: Walk around Aegis Assault or wait out its 22s; use Courage's tenacity on the Shield Vault stun; Q out of the Grand Starfall slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3, Levels 4-5 and First item are all marked 'Skill' although the packet gives 3 to Pantheon and 4-5 and First item to Garen, and each row's why-text already says so.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen] at a 54.41% Garen win rate: he loses 1-3 to Comet Spear poke and the Shield Vault all-in, then owns everything from 4 once Courage and Judgment come online against a sustain-less burst pick.
audit.corrected: Level 3 to Pantheon 4/10; Levels 4-5 and First item to Garen 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is quoted at 14s, and the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice.
audit.why: Riot data: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18s, Comet Spear 11s at rank 1, Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1. Shield Vault's 13s and Aegis Assault's 22s are the two windows that decide whether a commit is free.
audit.corrected: 13s at rank 1 for the stun, 22s for the shield channel, and step-ups keyed to both.

audit.why: Survive levels 1-3, take over from 4, crush the sidelane on items — the early/mid/late prose is right and matches the packet once the passive claim is fixed.

edits.after: Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) starts his all-in; Courage's tenacity shortens that stun. Bait it, then step up.

edits.before: Commit on Shield Vault (Stun)’s cooldown, at your level/item spikes, and with jungle setup — bait his answer before you spend yours.
edits.after: Commit on Shield Vault's 13s downtime and at your spikes; if he sets Aegis Assault, walk around it — never spend your spin into the front.

notes: Mirror consistency: this restates the Pantheon-side audit's two findings from Garen's side — Courage's tenacity shortening the Shield Vault stun, and Decisive Strike's slow-break beating the Grand Starfall landing slow — so the two pages agree. The level chart is proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Not asserted: whether Judgment's damage from behind bypasses Aegis Assault's frontal invulnerability, or whether Demacian Justice can be cast into it — the kit says 'invulnerable to damage from the front' but does not settle either case, so the page says only 'walk around it'.
